title: tx_queue.c: pthread_mutex_init return value ignored
description: Line 217: pthread_mutex_init(&queue->lock, NULL) does not check the return value. If initialization fails (ENOMEM, EAGAIN), subsequent pthread_mutex_lock/unlock calls operate on an uninitialized mutex, which is undefined behavior per POSIX. This contrasts with line 462 where pthread_mutex_destroy return IS checked. Fix: check return and propagate error from tx_queue_init().
